title: UK trade mark application: will it reach registration?
prediction_question: For a UK domestic trade mark application filed with the Intellectual Property Office, will it reach registration as resolved in the frozen February-2018 open-data snapshot - predicted from features fixed at filing: mark text, Nice class coverage (45 binary columns), category of mark, mark type, series membership/count, owner country/region/postcode-area, and filing date?
prediction_time: The application's filing date (Europe/London). This is a clearly-labelled RETROSPECTIVE, single-snapshot task: every feature is a filing-time field AS RECORDED IN the one frozen 2018-02-13 snapshot (sha256 3b6063bed36a78e8a04f10a5383f2881f4072a1be13e706a81ab097fb56ee571). No claim of historical operational availability is made. Recorded vintage limitation: owner name/postcode/region/country are snapshot-vintage (assignment can move ownership after filing, and classes can be narrowed post-filing); the as-of policy is uniform for every row because there is exactly one vintage.
target_definition: Label = registered-by-snapshot. Positive: Registered date non-empty (statuses Registered, Merged, Dead, Removed, Expired, Cancelled, Surrendered all imply the mark reached registration; Merged has Registered date set in-file). Negative: Registered date empty AND status in {Refused, Withdrawn}. Censored (excluded from scoring, counted per cohort): Registered date empty AND any other status - Application Received, Examination, Pre-Publication, Application Published, Opposed, Appealed, Appealable, Registration Pending, and the undocumented Deleted / Deemed Not Filed / blank. Source columns for the label (Status, Registered, Published, Expired, Renewal Due Date) are excluded from the shipped features.
eligibility: Filed date in 2010-01-01..2016-12-31. The publisher's own coverage statement (Open data explained, section 3) lists ALL applications (any outcome) only from 1 January 2010; earlier filings appear mainly if subsequently registered. Measured: 2005-2009 cohorts show only 10-506 never-registered marks per year versus thousands in eligible years (2009: 499 of 25,163 - a registration-conditioned transition year), so eligibility starts at 2010 filings. One row per distinct trade mark: 16,892 multi-owner duplicate rows measured and deduplicated. Marks still in flight at the snapshot are censored, not scored.

as_of_policy.vintage: Single frozen snapshot, Last-Modified 2018-02-13, sha256-pinned. The publisher's own documentation warns: 'Online registers are dynamic and alter as the trade marks' status changes. As this data is a snapshot, it may not be directly comparable with official publications' - the record applies the stricter reading and claims only snapshot-vintage features.
as_of_policy.coverage_note_stale: The explained-document's coverage section says filings earlier than 31 August 2016; the measured max filing date in the Feb-2018 file is January 2018 (2017 cohort n=75,024; 2018 January n=6,221) - the published cutoff is stale, the file is richer. Eligibility still ends at 2016-12-31 filings because 2017+ cohorts are too censored to score (16,386/75,024).
as_of_policy.feature_vintage_caveat: Owner Name/Postcode/Region/Country and the class columns are snapshot-vintage (assignment can change ownership post-filing; classes can be narrowed). Declared limitation; robustness variant = drop owner fields, recorded as a construction decision.

parse_hazards: 94 rows carry embedded pipes inside Mark Text (76x63 fields, 15x64, 3x65) - right-anchored parsing (Class45..Class1 from the right, then the 17 leading fields) or exclusion-with-count; 53 rows have blank/invalid Filed; 3 rows are shifted international-registration clones (country values like 'Ireland'/'Switzerland' appearing in the status position).
10 rows carry a negative status with a Registered date set - the label rule keys on the Registered date (positive) and the count is asserted in-build.
239 rows have a Registered date with a status outside the registered-then-lapsed set - counted bucket, rule asserted in-build.

Statuses Deleted (196 marks 2010-2016), Deemed Not Filed (2), Appealed/Appealable (306 in 2017, few earlier) are NOT in the publisher's documented 16-value status table - all fall in the censored bucket by the label rule; construction asserts the per-cohort counts.

contracts.redistribution: SUPPORTED - Open Government Licence on the dataset's own instrument (v2 linked in section 5 of the explained document; v3 footer), class A: reuse including commercially, with attribution. Ship source terms preserved.
contracts.prediction_timing: SUPPORTED AS A DECLARED RETROSPECTIVE TASK - the instant (filing) precedes all outcome observation; every feature is a filing-time field of one uniform 2018-02-13 vintage; no historical operational-availability claim. Owner-field vintage caveat declared.
contracts.target: SUPPORTED - label derivable in-file from Status + Registered date; source columns excludable; censoring distinguished from observed absence and counted per cohort (the chilecompra outcome-conditioning pattern, declared with measured rates: scored population is applications resolved by snapshot; censoring 0.02%-1.02% of eligible cohorts).
contracts.split_capacity: SUPPORTED - measured from the full source: 106,990 / 97,258 / 115,130 scored rows with 14,322 / 15,569 / 15,785 negatives in disjoint filing-year windows, both classes in every window and every year.
contracts.not_a_mirror: SUPPORTED (novelty_check verdict: differentiated) - no ML-ready UK trade-mark registration-outcome benchmark exists; adjacent prior art targets different outcomes (USPTO distinctiveness, EUTMR pairwise confusion) or is a proprietary tool (IPO Pre-Apply, Rocketeer) or aggregate statistics (facts-and-figures workbooks).

construction_handoff.step: On a worker: fetch the pinned zip (sha256 verify), stream-parse UTF-16LE pipe-separated with right-anchored field recovery, dedup multi-owner rows by mark number, apply eligibility (filed 2010-01-01..2016-12-31) and the label rule with per-cohort censored counts, emit one row per distinct mark with filing-time features only (mark text, class booleans + class count, category, mark type, series flag/count, owner country/region/postcode-area, filed date; Status/Published/Registered/Expired/Renewal excluded), write quality.json with evaluation_contract declaring the retrospective single-snapshot scope and the owner-vintage caveat, assert in-build: the three fixtures, the cross-check tolerance vs Trade_marks_2016.xlsx National applications (+-1%), the 94-pipe-row handling, the 10 neg_with_regdate rows, and per-split counts equal to this record's splits.
construction_handoff.expected_artifact: ipo-tm-001: train/eval/holdout CSVs at ~107k/97k/115k rows, meta.json, quality.json (gate 1.5 evaluation_contract), build/fixutes in source/.
construction_handoff.success_check: dataset-qualification gate 1.5.x passes on the full artifact on the worker, exact-byte --accept, THEN reference baselines (class-conditional rate, mark-type rate, owner-country rate, calendar month) before any model figure; the sector/class-conditional reference is the required comparator.

novelty_check.theirs: Adjacent prior art exists but none publishes this task in ML-ready form: Automating Abercrombie (Wiley JELS) predicts USPTO inherent-distinctiveness from US office actions - different target and jurisdiction; TrademarkML (TU Wien 2023) predicts EUTMR pairwise likelihood of confusion - different target; the UK IPO Pre-Apply tool and commercial tools (Rocketeer) predict outcomes but publish no dataset, splits or scored contract; IPO facts-and-figures workbooks are aggregate counts; Kaggle/HF/Zenodo searches returned no UK trade-mark registration benchmark.
novelty_check.ours: First open, ML-ready UK trade-mark registration-outcome benchmark: formulation (registered-by-snapshot from filing-time features), 2010-2016 cohort eligibility with measured censoring rules, disjoint filing-year splits (106,990/97,258/115,130 scored rows), named fixtures, and honest reference baselines, built from the only open bulk snapshot of UK trade mark applications (sha256-pinned Feb-2018 vintage).
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
